global_settings.description: Global Entangle settings block. Typically includes logging, cache, and database configuration.

renderers.description: List of renderer instances to manage. Each entry defines a renderer with its own settings.

name.description: Unique name for this renderer instance.

host.description: Hostname or IP address for this renderer.

port.description: Port number the renderer listens on.

workers.description: Number of worker threads to allocate for rendering.

output_dir.description: Directory where rendered outputs will be stored.

use_gpu.description: Enable GPU-accelerated rendering for this instance.

timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds before a render job is considered failed.

env_vars.description: Optional key-value pairs of environment variables passed to the renderer process.

notifications.description: List of notification endpoints (e.g., email, webhook, Slack) for system alerts. Each item has a type and endpoint.

type.description: Notification channel type (e.g., email, webhook, slack).

endpoint.description: Destination for notifications (e.g., email address, webhook URL, Slack incoming webhook).
